'''Breyer Chorn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior at the time of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest of the galaxy]]. Breyer was a member of [[Clan Chorn]], and he sported [[Color/Legends|gold and grey]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].

Later, when [[Mandalore the Avenger]] rallied the clans against the Eternal Empire, Breyer Chorn and his clan were among those to answer. And during the attack on the [[Darvannis]] droid factory, he was assigned the task of attacking the droid factory's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Breyer and his clan were first introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''. When Breyer's task force are outflanked by [[Skytrooper]]s in Chapter XIV, the player could have the choice of sacrificing or saving him and his comrades.<ref name="KOTFE" />
